segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: I wanted to revisit the revenue analytics access.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: The current requirement is that admins and finance managers can access those metrics, while support users cannot.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: But our customer support leads now need access to the monthly revenue summary as well. They don't need the detailed customer-value breakdown.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: So you're changing the existing access rule rather than creating a completely new analytics feature?

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: And they should only get the monthly summary?

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: The existing backend authorization is already implemented.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: Then we shouldn't build the authorization system again.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: Right. We only need to modify the permission for the monthly summary endpoint.

segments.speaker: Neha
segments.text: And I'll update the dashboard so support leads see the monthly summary but not the detailed revenue cards.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: Good. QA should also test that normal support users still don't get access.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: Let's make that the change for this release.
